name: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting
oracle_text:
Cast this spell only if you control two or more Doctors.
Take an extra turn after this one. Exile Twice Upon a Time.
blocked_sentences: Cast this spell only if you control two or more Doctors.

needs.what: a card-level cast restriction carrying a condition (condition_keys, e.g. a cmp of {count: {controller: you, subtypes: [Doctor]}} >= 2) checked when the spell is proposed for casting, so the spell cannot be cast at all unless it holds (601.3)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_only_during (CastWindowModel) takes only turn/steps/phase, not a board condition; alternative_cost's condition gates a price, not legality; an `if` in spell_effects would let the spell be cast and merely do nothing, which is a different card

notes: The packet also omits the Adventure half Unlikely Meeting ({2}{U} Instant — Adventure: search your library for a Doctor card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle); its oracle text was not joined into oracle_text, so it will need authoring as a second_face with adventure once the front is expressible.
